name: I need to import my existing

messages.content: Now that my Google account is connected, inspect the available project files and GitHub integration. Explain exactly how I can import my existing TRUE TALK repository or upload my original HTML file from my iPhone. Do not create another project, delete files, or modify anything yet.

### Current Status & Inspection

* **Connected Repository**: `https://github.com/henriquemenatzeachofc/my-project.git` (branch: `main`)
* **Project Files**: The workspace currently only contains [`.gitignore`](https://github.com/henriquemenatzeachofc/my-project/blob/main/.gitignore) and internal `.antigravity/` metadata. There are no website or application files (`index.html`, stylesheets, scripts) yet.
* **Auto-Sync**: Any file added or updated here is automatically committed and pushed to your GitHub repository after each turn.

---

### How to Bring in Your TRUE TALK Repository or HTML File

You do not need to create a new project or change repos. You can bring your project in using whichever method is easiest from your iPhone:

#### Option 1: Import directly from an existing GitHub repository
If your **TRUE TALK** project is already on GitHub (e.g., under your account as `henriquemenatzeachofc/<repo-name>` or public):
1. Simply reply here with the repository name or URL.
2. I will fetch the files and place them into this workspace.
3. Everything will instantly sync to `henriquemenatzeachofc/my-project` and be viewable right away.

---

#### Option 2: Upload / Paste the HTML file from your iPhone
If the file is stored locally on your iPhone (in the Files app, Notes, or iCloud):

* **Method A (Fastest on Mobile - Copy & Paste):**
  1. Open your HTML file on your iPhone (in Files, Quick Look, or a text viewer).
  2. Copy the entire HTML text.
  3. Paste it in a reply here and say: *"Save this as index.html"* (and any CSS/JS files if separate).

* **Method B (File Attachment):**
  1. If your chat prompt has a file attachment button (`+` or paperclip), tap it and select the file from the iPhone Files app.
  2. Send it with instructions on where it should be saved.

* **Method C (Upload to GitHub via Safari):**
  1. Open [github.com/henriquemenatzeachofc/my-project](https://github.com/henriquemenatzeachofc/my-project) in Safari.
  2. Tap **Add file** $\rightarrow$ **Upload files**, choose the file from your iPhone, and commit to `main`.
  3. Let me know when it's done, and I will pull the files down.

---

No files have been added, deleted, or changed. Whenever you are ready, let me know which method you prefer!

My actual TRUE TALK repository is:

https://github.com/henriquemenatzeachofc/TRUE-TALK

Please inspect this repository and determine whether you can access its files. If accessible, import the complete existing project into the current workspace, preserving its original directory structure and all files.

Do not replace the project with a demo, do not delete existing files, and do not invent missing code or Supabase credentials.

Before making changes, report which files are present in the repository and whether they contain the actual TRUE TALK website.
